title: The stale-refresh sentence reused the nowrap badge style and stretched the 390 px page
where: production (https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev), mobile 390×844, product page at 500 g
trigger: The persisted store crossed the 8 h REFRESH_STALE_MS threshold at about 23:52 UTC, so renderFooterStatus() rendered the amber sentence “Scheduled refresh overdue by 8.1 h — prices may be out of date.” for the first time in the deployed build.

failingChecks: mobile: the best card fits the viewport without horizontal scrolling — {"card":{"bottom":836,"left":16,"right":359,"top":302},"overflow":true}

promotion: the offer details name the published promotion and keep the vendor wording — the production fallback line reads “(multipacks excluded, applied from the validated published-rule fallback)”, which the QA regex did not allow

overflowDiagnostic.script: one-off headless-Chrome WebDriver evaluation against the production URL

offender.text: Scheduled refresh overdue by 8.1 h — prices may be out of date.

evidence.rootCause: public/style.css .status sets white-space: nowrap for short badges (IN STOCK, checkout certainty). public/product.js reused the same classes for the sentence-level freshness warning, so the sentence could not wrap.

fix.css: Added a .status--note modifier (display: block; white-space: normal; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal) for sentence-level statuses; the badge styling stays nowrap.
fix.js: public/product.js renderFooterStatus() now uses 'status status--stale status--note' for the stale-refresh sentence and the failing-sources line.
fix.qa: Added a fixture-QA check that loads the stale terms-server board at 390×844 and asserts the sentence has white-space: normal, its right edge fits the viewport and document scrollWidth does not exceed it; also relaxed the promotion-details regex to allow the documented fallback suffix.

verifiedLocally.offlineFixtures: 86/86 checks pass (docs/evidence/browser-qa-fixtures-20261013T0004Z.json), including 'mobile: the stale-refresh sentence wraps inside the viewport instead of stretching the page' — {found:true, innerWidth:390, right:359, scrollWidth:375, whiteSpace:'normal'}

productionRecheck: PASS — after the fix deployed through main-push Workers Builds, production browser QA re-run at 2026-10-13T00:04Z passed 82/82 with zero console errors: 'mobile: the stale-refresh sentence wraps inside the viewport instead of stretching the page' {found:true, innerWidth:390, right:359, scrollWidth:375, whiteSpace:'normal'} and 'mobile: the best card fits the viewport without horizontal scrolling' {overflow:false}. Evidence: docs/evidence/browser-qa-production-20261013T0004Z.json and docs/evidence/visual-review/production-*-20261013T0004Z.png.
note: This defect was hidden until the store became stale; the fixture QA had not exercised the stale sentence at mobile width. It is unrelated to the promotion values, which rendered correctly in production (₪237.60 item subtotal, ₪262.60 delivered total at 2 kg).
